verdict.rationale: YubiKey is a hardware authentication device. Secrets are generated and stored on the key's secure element, and the product does not ingest user content into any model-bearing service, so an AI-training opt-out is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Yubico collecting user data for AI training or offering any related control, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
